summary: Read all 18 owned units (s0002-s0019); none states a birth, death year or age beyond Hui's undated 廆卒, which Jinshu 108 fixes at AD 333. Huang's 建武初 (317) and 太甯末 (325-326) appointments and the 333-334 post-death revolt sequence are supported. Three defects: Hui's Liaodong dukedom and Huang's heir status (s0006) are falsely dated 317; the two mothers carry an invented reign-wide window; and ten persons' hints narrow a 333-334 window to 333.

itemChecks.event: Murong Hui's own elevation to Duke of Liaodong.
itemChecks.reason: s0006 廆為遼東公 carries no date; 建武初 belongs to s0007 (Huang's appointments). Jinshu 108 records Hui declining 昌黎公 at 建武初 and only later 進封遼東郡公 after the 太興初 war, so AD 317 is unsupported.

itemChecks.event: Murong Huang's own establishment as heir (世子) of Murong Hui.
itemChecks.reason: s0006 立為世子 is tied to Hui's undated dukedom, not to 建武初 in s0007; the AD 317 year is borrowed from the next sentence and is unverified.
